newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Stockpile to hold cobalt meeting on July 31.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Stockpile to hold cobalt meeting on July 31.

text.p: U.S. Defense National Stockpile Center said it will hold a cobalt industry meeting on July 31 to discuss a draft solicitation offering 1.5 million lbs of cobalt by negotiated bid in September.
Stockpile said it planned to issue the draft solicitation by July 18.
The meeting will be held at the Doubletree Hotel National Airport, Arlington, Va., at 1000 to 1300EDT/1400 to 1700GMT.
Stockpile cobalt sales were suspended in March when the government agency and trader Minor Metals Inc became embroiled in two separate legal battles which have since been largely resolved.
Stockpile also plans to offer 500,000 lbs of cobalt for sale by sealed bid in August.
